item.title: 3 things to know about naval blockades as U.S. begins patrols in the Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: The White House says it wants to choke off Iran's oil export revenue. But experts say that blockades are often unpredictable and difficult to enforce.

item.title: Russian missiles and drones bombard Ukraine in hourslong attack
item.summary: Russia hammered civilian areas of Ukraine with hundreds of drones and dozens of missiles in an attack that stretched for hours killing at least 16 people.

item.title: Jet fuel prices double, leading airlines to increase baggage fees, raise fares
item.summary: Airlines are facing higher costs, and one airport group in Europe has warned of the risk of a "systemic jet fuel shortage" if traffic through the Strait of Hormuz doesn't normalize by the end of this month.

item.title: Indonesia's capital of the future faces doubts in the present
item.summary: Indonesia is racing to build a new capital, promising a greener, futuristic city. But many citizens aren't convinced it will live up to the vision.

item.title: French government seeking release of 86-year-old French widow detained by ICE
item.summary: The French government is pressing the U.S. Department of Homeland Security to release the 86-year-old French widow of a military veteran from immigration custody in Louisiana after she was detained earlier this month.

item.title: How seals' whiskers make them master underwater hunters
item.summary: Their sensitive facial hair may be the harbor seals superpower for tracking fish, scientists are learning.

item.title: 'Dear America': HUD workers say they're being blocked from doing their jobs
item.summary: A website with anonymous employee letters accuses the Trump administration of undermining work on housing discrimination. HUD says it's restoring "sanity" to fair housing enforcement.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] Hungarian Americans say Orbán's defeat could provide roadmap for countering Trump
item.summary: Hungarian Americans say Viktor Orbán's defeat in Hungary provides a blueprint for countering President Trump's attempts to tilt the electoral playing field ahead of the midterms.

item.title: [PENDING_TRANSLATION] A Polymarket trader made $300,000 betting on Biden's pardons, a new analysis shows
item.summary: In the final hours of President Biden's term, an anonymous prediction market trader placed lucrative bets on who would be pardoned even as the odds were nearly zero.

item.title: 'Beef' is less rare in Season 2, but still well done
item.summary: The hit Netflix series brings in a new cast that includes Oscar Isaac and Carey Mulligan, and even more beef.
